process_area.title: National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy

value_stream.name: Government Affairs, Public Policy & Industry Relations

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, CEO, Entity leadership
fields.Trigger: Annual planning; new stakeholder; leadership change

workflows.name: National Government Stakeholder Mapping & Relationship Management

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate executive participation" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "Govt Affairs Mgr track engagement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
- operational: proactive mapping; operational: ethics policy
Pain Points / Risks: - **Relationship-gap risk**: Key stakeholders unknown/unengaged when a policy issue arises; mitigated by proactive mapping
- **Ethics risk**: Improper relationship cultivation creates bribery/conflict exposure (links to VS-86.3/W3360); mitigated by ethics policy
System Touchpoints: - Stakeholder/CRM tool; records (links to VS-88); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr build and maintain the national stakeholder map: legislators (Senators, Representatives, relevant committees — trade, labor, finance, ways & means), executive agencies (DTI, DOLE, BIR, BSP, NTC, DENR, DTI-BPS, ARTA, FDA), regulators, and local-government leagues at the national level

Govt Affairs Mgr cultivate and manage relationships: briefings, meetings, site visits, information sharing, and BuildRight positioning as a credible industry voice; coordinate executive participation (W3359)

Govt Affairs Mgr track engagement (CRM-style), relationship health, and issues per stakeholder; brief leadership and coordinate with LGU relationship work (links to VS-76.3) and labor liaison (links to VS-84.3 W2894)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Legal (links to VS-100/VS-22.3), Compliance (links to VS-22), Tax (links to VS-79), affected business units
fields.Volume: Bills, IRRs, agency issuances, draft regulations

workflows.name: Legislative & Regulatory Monitoring, Horizon Scanning & Impact Assessment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-scan of "scan emerging issues" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal assess business impact of each tracked" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-register of "Govt Affairs Mgr publish monthly regulatory/legislative digest to leadership" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-155 (ensure lawful political engagement & lobbying disclosure.)
- operational: horizon scanning; operational: cross-functional impact assessment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-detection risk**: Learning of a regulation after enactment limits response; mitigated by horizon scanning
- **Impact-miss risk**: Failing to see a rule's BuildRight-specific impact; mitigated by cross-functional impact assessment
System Touchpoints: - Monitoring/intelligence tool; risk register (links to VS-21.2); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr monitor legislative and regulatory activity: filed bills, pending IRRs, agency draft issuances, public consultations (BIR revenue regulations, DTI consumer rules, DOLE labor orders, BSP payments, DENR environmental, customs/tariff per VS-87, data privacy per VS-91); horizon-scan emerging issues

Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal assess business impact of each tracked item (revenue, cost, compliance, operations) across BuildRight's segments; prioritize by materiality and timeline; coordinate with regulatory-change execution (links to VS-22.3)

Govt Affairs Mgr publish monthly regulatory/legislative digest to leadership and affected units, feed impacts into risk register (links to VS-21.2) and planning (links to VS-33), and brief executives on priority items (W3359)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, affected business units, CEO, Legal (links to VS-100), Comms (links to VS-14.3)

workflows.name: Public Policy Position Development & Advocacy Campaign Execution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-issue of "Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal develop BuildRight's policy position on the" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "Govt Affairs Mgr execute the advocacy campaign" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Govt Affairs Mgr report outcome, capture lessons, update position/strategy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
- operational: cross-functional review; operational: executive sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misalignment risk**: Public position contradicts BuildRight practice/values; mitigated by cross-functional review
- **Over-reach risk**: Advocacy beyond BuildRight's interest/authority; mitigated by executive sign-off
System Touchpoints: - Advocacy tracking; records (links to VS-88); comms (links to VS-14.3); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal develop BuildRight's policy position on the issue: analysis, options (support/oppose/amend), recommended position, rationale, and ask; obtain executive sign-off per authority (links to VS-36)

Govt Affairs Mgr execute the advocacy campaign: targeted meetings (W3356), written submissions (W3357), coalition building (W3358), and selective public/industry communication (coordinate with Comms links to VS-14.3); track progress
Govt Affairs Mgr report outcome, capture lessons, update position/strategy as the issue evolves, and document the position and engagement record (links to VS-88) for audit and continuity

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Leadership, VP Legal & Compliance, affected SMEs, Compliance (links to VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Govt Affairs Mgr plan the engagement" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with compliance execution" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document the engagement, commitments, and follow-ups" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
- operational: briefings and rehearsal; operational: ethics guardrails
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unprepared-spokesperson risk**: Weak engagement undermines BuildRight's position; mitigated by briefings and rehearsal
- **Ethics risk**: Engagement crossing into improper influence (links to VS-86.3/W3360); mitigated by ethics guardrails
System Touchpoints: - CRM/engagement record; records (links to VS-88); briefing materials

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr plan the engagement: objective, audience (committee chair, agency director), BuildRight spokespeople, briefing materials, and ask; secure executive availability (W3359) and legal review

Govt Affairs Mgr/Leadership conduct the engagement (meeting, hearing, consultation, site visit): present BuildRight's position and data, listen, answer questions, and build credibility; coordinate with compliance execution (links to VS-22.2) where relevant
Govt Affairs Mgr document the engagement, commitments, and follow-ups; execute follow-up (W3357 submissions, further engagement), update stakeholder map (W3353), and brief leadership

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Legal (links to VS-100), affected SMEs, Tax (links to VS-79), Customs (links to VS-87), VP Legal & Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "Govt Affairs Mgr coordinate the submission" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "file the submission within the consultation deadline" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Govt Affairs Mgr track the consultation outcome, share with" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
- operational: tracking and SLA; operational: coordination and sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missed-deadline risk**: Late submission excluded from record; mitigated by tracking and SLA
- **Inconsistent-input risk**: Conflicting BuildRight positions across units; mitigated by coordination and sign-off
System Touchpoints: - Agency portals; records (links to VS-88); compliance (links to VS-22.3)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr coordinate the submission: assemble subject input (tax per VS-79, customs per VS-87, labor per VS-84, privacy per VS-91, consumer/retail), draft position paper/comments, and legal review (links to VS-100)

Govt Affairs Mgr file the submission within the consultation deadline (agency portal, committee secretary), ensure formality/attribution, and coordinate with coalition partners (W3358) for aligned/endorsed submissions
Govt Affairs Mgr track the consultation outcome, share with affected units for compliance readiness (links to VS-22.3), and archive the submission record (links to VS-88)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, VP Legal & Compliance, Industry partners, Associations (links to W3361), Legal (links to VS-100/VS-86)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify coalition opportunities on shared issues" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System workflow orchestration of "Govt Affairs Mgr build/manage the coalition" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track coalition effectiveness, sustain the alliance on ongoing issues, and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
- operational: legal review and guardrails; operational: role clarity
Pain Points / Risks: - **Antitrust risk**: Coalition activity crossing into collusion (links to VS-86); mitigated by legal review and guardrails
- **Free-rider risk**: Partners benefit without contributing; mitigated by role clarity
System Touchpoints: - Coalition/association tracking (links to W3361); legal/antitrust (links to VS-86); records (links to VS-88)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr identify coalition opportunities on shared issues (retail, tax, payments, supply chain, labor, consumer) and potential partners (industry associations per W3361, peer companies, sector groups); assess competition-law boundaries (links to VS-76.2 W2683, VS-86)

Govt Affairs Mgr build/manage the coalition: align positions, divide advocacy roles, coordinate submissions (W3357) and engagements (W3356), and present a unified industry voice; manage confidentiality and antitrust guardrails (links to VS-86)
Govt Affairs Mgr track coalition effectiveness, sustain the alliance on ongoing issues, and capture BuildRight's contribution and influence (W3368)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Leadership/CEO, VP Legal & Compliance, Executive Assistant
fields.Trigger: Continuous; engagement cycle; board reporting (links to VS-36.1)

workflows.name: Government Affairs Calendar, Briefing & Executive Liaison

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepare briefings for executive/CEO engagements" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report external-affairs activity and outcomes to leadership and the board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-541 (ensure controlled execution — National Government Relations & Public Policy Advocacy (PA-104.1).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Engagement-overload risk**: Executive time over-committed; mitigated by prioritization
- **Briefing-gap risk**: Executives engage unprepared; mitigated by structured briefings
System Touchpoints: - Calendar/CRM; records (links to VS-88); governance/board (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr maintain the government-affairs calendar (legislative sessions, agency consultations, association events, key deadlines) and prioritize executive engagements by impact

Govt Affairs Mgr prepare briefings for executive/CEO engagements: stakeholder profile, issue background, BuildRight position, talking points, and ask; conduct rehearsals and provide on-site support (W3356)
Govt Affairs Mgr debrief after engagements, capture commitments and follow-ups, and report external-affairs activity and outcomes to leadership and the board (links to VS-36.1)

fields.Participants: Govt Affairs Mgr, Legal (links to VS-100), Compliance (links to VS-22), Anti-Corruption (links to VS-86.3), Internal Audit (links to VS-21.1)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal maintain the political-activity and ethics framework" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Govt Affairs Mgr screen all engagements, hospitality, and contributions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report compliance to the board/audit committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-155 (ensure lawful political engagement & lobbying disclosure.)
- operational: ethics framework and screening; operational: records and review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bribery/corruption risk**: Improper payments/hospitality to officials (links to VS-86.3); mitigated by ethics framework and screening
- **Disclosure-failure risk**: Missed lobbying/financial disclosures create liability; mitigated by records and review
System Touchpoints: - Ethics/anti-bribery (links to VS-86.3); records (links to VS-88); audit (links to VS-21.1); legal (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: Govt Affairs Mgr/Legal maintain the political-activity and ethics framework: code of conduct for government engagement, gift/entertainment limits (links to VS-86.3 anti-bribery), political-contribution policy, and lobbying disclosure obligations

Govt Affairs Mgr screen all engagements, hospitality, and contributions against the framework and anti-corruption policy (links to VS-86.3); obtain required approvals and maintain records (links to VS-88)

Govt Affairs Mgr/Compliance maintain disclosure records, support internal audit (links to VS-21.1) and any government inquiry (links to VS-22.2/VS-100), and report compliance to the board/audit committee (links to VS-36)
